races.paceDynamic: Kinnalargy, Ambishio, Straight Ahead, and Sands Of Josepi will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this competitive handicap. The pace will be honest throughout with multiple front-runners committed to the lead, creating a searching test that should expose any lack of fitness or stamina. The sustained tempo will set up the race perfectly for horses that can close strongly from off the pace. This race shape clearly favors hold-up horses and prominent racers with a strong finishing kick over the pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners engage early and maintain pressure throughout
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will find out the leaders in the final furlong, allowing the better-class hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Noble Vow and Big Fun are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their proven finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Kinnalargy and Ambishio dispute the early lead more aggressively than expected
scenarios.body: The faster tempo will create an even stronger setup for closers but may also compromise some of the hold-up horses' chances if they get too far back. Under The Radar and Go Vince Go can bridge the gap between pace and stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easier time than expected by opening up a decisive advantage
scenarios.body: Straight Ahead or Ambishio could steal a march if the pace becomes more measured than anticipated, though this seems unlikely with four confirmed front-runners. The lack of pressure would allow a front-runner to see out the trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If several front-runners cancel each other out completely in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The race could develop into a sprint finish with multiple horses converging in the final furlong, favoring those with the best recent form regardless of running style. Dazzling Haze and Mighty Magnus could capitalize on their higher ratings.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Kinnalargy and Ambishio go too fast early as this will set up a perfect storm for the closers
Monitor Straight Ahead's fitness after 162 days off as any lack of condition will be quickly exposed
Keep an eye on Noble Vow's position turning for home as his recent strong finishes make him dangerous
Watch for traffic problems with multiple hold-up horses (Big Fun, Here Forever, Explosive Finnish) needing room
Observe if Under The Radar can secure a prominent position early as his course form gives him an edge

races.paceDynamic: Vantheman and Mon Na Slieve will set the early pace with Far Above The Law, Spring Is Sprung, and Copper Knight tracking in the prominent positions. With 18 runners over 5f on good ground, this will likely be a strong gallop from the start. The pace-setters create pressure on each other, particularly Vantheman coming off his front-running win at Hamilton. This race shape favors prominent runners who can sit just off the pace and hold-up horses with a turn of foot, as the early leaders may compromise each other in a competitive sprint.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong between Vantheman, Mon Na Slieve and the prominent group
scenarios.body: The pace-setters weaken in the final furlong allowing hold-up horses to surge through. Runners like Montezuma and Muker who can quicken late benefit from the strong early gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Group Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Vantheman or the tracking group can control the fractions without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run and hold off the closers in a tactical affair. Far Above The Law and Kinetic Force are well-placed to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Vantheman can dictate a more measured pace like at Hamilton
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more sustainable allowing the leader to kick clear in the final furlong. Vantheman's recent form and blinkers give him the edge to repeat his Hamilton success.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes From Back
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly strong and the main fancies falter
scenarios.body: A longshot with fresh legs and a low weight takes advantage of the collapse ahead. Changeofmind's recent win and low OR or Woohoo's light weight could prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Vantheman and Mon Na Slieve go too fast early as both are natural front-runners who could compromise each other
Monitor how Montezuma settles after his disappointing effort over 6f at Hamilton as he needs the drop back to 5f
Check if Mondammej cooperates after refusing to leave parade ring in November and being off for 211 days
Observe if the hold-up horses like Muker and Acrisius get the strong pace they need to be effective late
Note whether Far Above The Law can handle the 6lb rise after his narrow Ascot success

races.paceDynamic: Serenity Blue is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a measured tempo without pressure from the break. Penzance, Spanish Hustle and Eroico can sit prominent but none are obliged to challenge early. The vast majority are hold-up horses including Great Bedwyn, Cabrera, Optician, Brielle, Fast Fred, Letsbefrank, Valley Of Flowers and Damascus Steel who will be content to track the steady gallop. This uncontested pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy and deliver late challenges over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Pace Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Serenity Blue leads unchallenged and sets moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The steady tempo allows hold-up horses to conserve maximum energy before unleashing finishing kicks. Late closers benefit from the tactical advantage of racing behind horses and timing their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If Penzance or Spanish Hustle challenge Serenity Blue early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates gaps for horses with tactical speed. Those able to sit handy without over-racing gain positional advantages as others struggle to close from behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays very slow until the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: The sprint finish from the back becomes chaotic with traffic problems likely. Horses with proven turn of foot from unpromising positions can weave through and strike late when others tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Serenity Blue goes too slow and gets swamped early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble with new leaders emerging mid-race. Adaptable horses who can change tactics and those drawn well gain advantages in the reshuffled running order.

watchPoints.text: Serenity Blue must be watched for early pace judgment as sole leader could get away with soft fractions
Fast Fred and Spanish Hustle worth monitoring given stable's good recent form despite questionable last runs
Great Bedwyn and Letsbefrank deserve focus as proven hold-up horses getting ideal tactical scenario
Brielle and Cabrera both return from long breaks so watch for market confidence indicators
Valley Of Flowers and Damascus Steel could outrun odds if pace setup develops as expected

races.name: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap

runners_data.name: Toyotomi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who got upset at Ascot last time, needs things to fall right from this style in a big field
runners_data.spotlight: Having been gelded he made a promising reappearance at Newcastle (6f, AW) last month; failed to build on that when sixth at Ascot (6f, good) but he got upset in the stalls; well handicapped on his French form up to last July and he's not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Russet Gold
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer for new yard, 0-20 recent record but showing promise in current form
runners_data.comment: Losing run continues but he's shown promise on both runs for new yard this spring
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten on his last 20 starts going back to June 2023 but he's shown promise in fifth this spring on his first two starts for this yard, most recently behind a couple of these in a big field at York (6f, good); he continues to edge down the weights and might not be far away.

runners_data.name: Strike Red
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 6f win two starts back, high draw was negative at York last time
runners_data.comment: Won at Leicester last month and a high draw proved to be a negative at York last time
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten behind Dark Thirty and others at York (6f, good) last time but his high draw proved to be a negative; won at Leicester (6f, good to firm) two starts ago and he could bounce back today and be involved.

runners_data.name: Annaf
runners_data.note: Group 3 winner on dangerous mark, hold-up style but hasn't fired in four runs since returning
runners_data.comment: Group 3 winner at Ascot last October but he hasn't been at the top of his game this season
runners_data.spotlight: Group 3 winner at Ascot (6f, soft) last October and he's versatile ground-wise; down to a dangerous mark but he hasn't been at the top of his game on his four runs this year, in handicaps on the last two occasions, and he needs to turn things around in a first-time tongue-tie and reapplied cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Dark Thirty
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won big-field York handicap this month, proven in this type of race
runners_data.comment: Returned to form to win in big field at York; 6lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run
runners_data.spotlight: Returned to form to win big-field handicap at York (6f, good) this month on third stable start, going one better than in the same race 12 months previously; a 6lb rise shouldn't be enough to prevent another big run.

runners_data.name: Al Shabab Storm
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will ensure a pace, wide draw cost him at Chester last time
runners_data.comment: Ran better than finishing position suggests at Chester on stable debut; well handicapped
runners_data.spotlight: Finished down the field on stable/seasonal debut at Chester (7.5f) this month but that doesn't tell the full story as he ran well for a long way from his wide draw and was hampered late on; he's dropped to an attractive mark and is just the type his new trainer does very well with.

runners_data.name: Eternal Sunshine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with perfect 3-3 Thirsk record, return to this track is key positive
runners_data.comment: Completed hat-trick last August/September but soundly beaten on her three runs this season
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick last August/September and she's capable of going close off her current mark if at her best; she's 3-3 here and perhaps the return to Thirsk will trigger a revival, but it very much needs to as she's not shone on her three outings this season.

runners_data.name: Fluorescence
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 252-day break, previous 6f wins suggest distance suits
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 4yo for whom the return to 6f could be a good move on her reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Made it three wins from his five starts when landing a handicap at Redcar (5f, good to firm) last August; her two other wins came at 6f; returned to form when staying on for fourth of 14 at Southwell (5f, AW) last September when last seen and the return to 6f could be a good move on her comeback.

runners_data.name: Milford
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from wind surgery, was competitive in quality handicaps before
runners_data.spotlight: 0-14 since debut win in May 2024 but he often ran well in some quality handicaps last season; returns on a competitive mark having had wind surgery; could have a part to play if fully tuned up.

runners_data.name: Manila Scouse
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course and distance win last July off 1lb higher mark
runners_data.spotlight: His last win came over C&D last July (good; off 1lb higher) and he stayed on for a close third at Hamilton (5f, good) a fortnight ago; could build on that latest performance now back up in trip; firmly in calculations.

runners_data.name: Sir Yoshi
runners_data.note: Hold-up type on competitive mark but well beaten on stable debut and again at York
runners_data.comment: Competitive mark but well beaten on final run last year and same outcome on reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: He's on a competitive mark on last season's best form for David Marnane but he was well beaten on his stable debut at York last October and it was the same outcome there this month on his return; he has plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Fandom
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse back on song with third to Dark Thirty at York, second stable start
runners_data.comment: Back on song when third in big field at York and in the mix if confirming that promise
runners_data.spotlight: Globetrotter who has had mixed fortunes across his career but he was back on song when third of 22 to Dark Thirty at York (6f, good) this month on his second stable start; he can be in the mix if confirming that promise.

runners_data.name: Yes I'm Mali
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with C&D win last month, 1 length second at York last Saturday shows current form
runners_data.comment: Close 2nd at York last Saturday; could still have more to offer for this yard; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Won over C&D (good) last month on second stable start; midfield finish at Newbury (6f, good) next time before 1l second of 20 at York (6f, good) last Saturday; he could still have more to offer for this yard; respected.

runners_data.name: Gangsta Man
runners_data.note: Prominent type who failed to settle at Newmarket last time, better at shorter trips
runners_data.comment: Went close at Musselburgh on his stable debut and had excuses at Newmarket last time
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten at Newmarket last month (7f, good; has won at that trip in the past) but he failed to settle and didn't look at home on the track; prior to that he kept on strongly to go very close at Musselburgh (5f, soft) on his stable debut and he remains one to be interested in.

races.paceDynamic: Al Shabab Storm will be the primary pace-setter from stall position, with Dark Thirty, Manila Scouse, Eternal Sunshine, Fluorescence and Gangsta Man all showing prominent tendencies that could apply early pressure. With multiple prominent runners in a 14-runner field over 6f at Thirsk, the pace is likely to be solid to strong from the start, creating a genuine test of stamina in the final furlong. The abundance of hold-up horses (Toyotomi, Russet Gold, Strike Red, Annaf, Milford, Sir Yoshi, Fandom, Yes I'm Mali) suggests many will be relying on the pace collapsing, but with this many prominent runners the pace should be genuine enough to set up a finish where those with tactical speed who can position handily will have the edge over pure closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners (Dark Thirty, Manila Scouse, Eternal Sunshine, Fluorescence, Gangsta Man) all go forward with Al Shabab Storm
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and the field comes back to the hold-up horses who can quicken late. This favours the proven closers with tactical speed who can find gaps in a large field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Al Shabab Storm gets an easy lead with only 1-2 prominent runners applying pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more sustainable allowing horses with early speed to maintain their position into the finish. Those who can track the pace without over-racing will have the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get into a pace battle while Al Shabab Storm tries to steal a march
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start with horses getting into trouble, favouring those with racing room and tactical awareness from good draws. Experience and a cool jockey become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Al Shabab Storm gets left alone on the lead and none of the prominent runners want to engage early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole favouring those with the highest cruising speed who can accelerate quickest. Pure speed horses with proven finishing kicks will dominate.

watchPoints.text: Al Shabab Storm's early position will be crucial - if he gets an uncontested lead the pace could collapse and favour hold-up horses
The prominent runners Dark Thirty, Manila Scouse and Eternal Sunshine could create pace pressure that sets up the closers
Yes I'm Mali's finishing kick from his York second last Saturday suggests he's peaking at the right time
Strike Red's draw position will be telling given his high draw was negative at York last time
Fluorescence is returning from a 252-day break which adds uncertainty to his prominent running style

races.name: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Elysian Flame
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with smart staying form, 28 days since Beverley win but may face traffic issues
runners_data.comment: 2m win at Beverley (good to soft; 2lb higher today) in April; just 1m5f for sole run since
runners_data.spotlight: Smart staying handicapper for Mick and David Easterby in 2021 when competitive at some of the top meetings; only his second run since when winning over 2m at Beverley (good to soft; 2lb higher today) in April, while 1m5f helps to explain his last of five at Hamilton four weeks ago; not dismissed.

runners_data.name: Laafy
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist, 407 days off but showed partial recovery last season, ideal for pace collapse
runners_data.comment: Absent for 1373 days before last season; partial recovery last April but off again since
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly with Sir Michael Stoute, smart over 1m4f in 2020 when usually visored; absent for 1373 days before last season and staged a partial recovery when tried in cheekpieces at Musselburgh (1m6f) on second run back, admittedly in only eighth of 14 (beaten about 5l); dropped another 6lb since but also absent another 407 days.

runners_data.name: Artisan Dancer
runners_data.note: Dependable hold-up horse at this trip, poor turf record but race shape suits perfectly
runners_data.comment: Industrious and dependable sort at 1m6f-2m2f but his turf strike-rate is 1-19
runners_data.spotlight: Industrious and dependable sort at 1m6f-2m2f but turf strike-rate is 1-19; not discredited on latest start (1m5f) but others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Almuhit
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who thrived front-running last season, 57 days since last run freshens him up
runners_data.comment: Two front-running wins over 2m in four-runner Flat races last year; back up from 1m6f
runners_data.spotlight: Rediscovered the knack for new stable last year, including two front-running wins over 2m in four-runner Flat races and two places when the action got more competitive; returned to some hurdles form on last two outings in that sphere; a lesser show on Musselburgh Flat in between was over 1m6f but this race may also prove too tough.

runners_data.name: Mountain Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with significant ability intact, needs to build on seasonal comeback
runners_data.comment: Going back up from the 1m5f of last two runs should suit and he continues down the weights
runners_data.spotlight: 4-15 for David Simcock; four runs for current yard, absent 582 days before this season's, in which he showed that significant ability remains; needs to build on those performances but going back up from the 1m5f of last two outings should suit and he continues down the weights; case can be made.

runners_data.name: Hermetic
runners_data.note: Prominent French import with soft ground form, only one run on good going
runners_data.spotlight: Dual soft-ground winner (1m4f/2m) in France last autumn, from just four races there; picked up for 105,000euros in November and put up a bold show when fourth of 17 at York (1m4f, good) 18 days ago; stuck to his task at 20-1 that day and looks a strong candidate if that run has brought him on.

runners_data.name: St Faz
runners_data.note: Usually prominent, four wins this season including recent Musselburgh success over 2m
runners_data.spotlight: Usually races prominently; won four of his six starts for new yard this year, including when returned to turf for eight-runner race at Musselburgh (2m, good) in April; has excuses for the two defeats, on latest occasion fifth of 17 in the 2m2f Chester Plate despite the work he had to do to front-run from wide draw; one to note.

runners_data.name: Arrange
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare, 15lb below last winning mark but race shape favours her patient style
runners_data.comment: 15lb below peak mark but others seem to be banging on the door more loudly
runners_data.spotlight: Last won in August 2024; placed in three of eight starts last term and it was a hot race in which she was well beaten at York (40-1) on 2026 return; 15lb below peak mark but others seem to be banging on the door more loudly.

runners_data.name: Anniversary
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner, blinkered on recent starts, faces tactical pressure from Treasure Islands
runners_data.comment: Rallying second at Salisbury (1m6f, good; made most) latest start gives some renewed hope
runners_data.spotlight: Blinkered on four of his last five starts; flopped when 5-4 favourite behind Elysian Flame at Beverley (2m, good to soft) in April but this month's second of nine at Salisbury (1m6f, good; made most and rallied well) was his closest finish since 2yo and gives some renewed hope.

runners_data.name: Pole Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in first-time visor, back to form at Newmarket suggests revival
runners_data.comment: Back-to-form third with a first-time visor (1m6f) following lesser efforts over 2m2f/2m
runners_data.spotlight: Won two 1m6f handicaps last term; back-to-form third with a first-time visor at Newmarket (1m6f) four weeks ago, so he re-enters calculations despite earlier lesser efforts over 2m2f and 2m.

runners_data.name: New York Minute
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with AW hat-trick form, first-time visor could spark improvement
runners_data.comment: Return to 2m should be a big help but none of his turf form (5 races) approaches this mark
runners_data.spotlight: Headgear helped on AW last September-December, including for 1m6f/2m hat-trick; peak form was not repeated this year, including in two small fields this spring but they were at 1m3f/1m4f; returning to 2m should be a big help but none of his turf form (five races) approaches this mark.

runners_data.name: Minstrel Knight
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from hurdles, 245 days since flat action creates uncertainty
runners_data.comment: Won on good two years ago but record since has been dominated by achievements on softer
runners_data.spotlight: Ran creditably for minor honours in two (1m5f/2m2f) of his four starts in last year's Flat campaign and won novice hurdles in December and January when last seen; however, although he won on good ground two years ago, his record since has been dominated by achievements on softer.

runners_data.name: Treasure Islands
runners_data.note: Front-runner coming off make-all win at Ripon, low weight compensates for OR71 rating
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for the step up in trip when making all at Ripon (2m, good) late last month on his second handicap start; not discredited when second on soft ground at Haydock (2m) ten days ago; needs to resume progress but that might be possible for this lightly raced 4yo.

runners_data.name: Gibside
runners_data.note: Prominent style, Chester Plate winner last season but needs to leave disappointing recent form behind
runners_data.comment: On a good mark but needs to leave his four efforts this season a long way behind him
runners_data.spotlight: Strong finish from rear secured the Chester Plate (2m2f, good) last May off 3lb higher and he also won over 1m4f on soft at Catterick in October; needs to leave his four efforts this season a long way behind him, however.

races.paceDynamic: Anniversary and Treasure Islands will engage early, with Anniversary's front-running style clashing against Treasure Islands who made all at Ripon last time. Six prominent runners (Elysian Flame, Almuhit, Hermetic, St Faz, Pole Star, Minstrel Knight) create congestion behind the leaders, setting up tactical complications entering the home straight. The sustained gallop over 2m on good ground will expose stamina limitations and favour those who can settle off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Laafy, Artisan Dancer, Mountain Road, and Arrange who can exploit the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Anniversary and Treasure Islands maintain honest gallop with prominent pack bunching
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will stretch the field and create gaps for patient riders to exploit in the final 3f. Hold-up specialists with proven stamina reserves will have clear runs as the prominent brigade weakens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner can secure ideal position behind leaders without traffic issues
scenarios.body: Elysian Flame or St Faz could benefit from the pace while avoiding early congestion, timing their challenge perfectly. Their class and recent form gives them edge over pure front-runners and late closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Anniversary or Treasure Islands gets uncontested lead with others settling too far back
scenarios.body: The leader builds insurmountable advantage as field allows too much rope, with stamina reserves proving decisive. Treasure Islands' recent make-all success at Ripon makes him primary beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield tactical move
scenarios.trigger: If prominent pack creates complete traffic jam allowing midfield runner clean passage
scenarios.body: A horse like New York Minute or Gibside times run perfectly as favorites get hampered by pace dynamics. The AW experience of New York Minute could prove crucial in finding gaps.

races.name: Sky Bet Build A Bet Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Bintaziza
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent all-weather form but faces tactical disadvantage in congested field position
runners_data.spotlight: Won on debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in April and again had something to spare when following up at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW); she has the potential to be better than her opening mark and is one to consider.

runners_data.name: Thaluna
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly positioned for strong pace scenario with Haggas stable in good form
runners_data.spotlight: Won 2yo novice at York (6f, good) last October on second start; mid-division in Listed race later that month and reappeared with good second on handicap debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm); stayed on well last time and this step up to 1m could prompt further improvement; lots to like.

runners_data.name: Thankfully
runners_data.note: Prominent style puts her in the danger zone for traffic but has winning momentum from recent Beverley success
runners_data.comment: Won Beverley maiden last month and this 3yo is in good hands to progress
runners_data.spotlight: Promising third at Sandown (7f, soft) last August on the first of her two 2yo starts and reappeared with win in a maiden at Beverley last month (8.4f, good to soft; unraced on softer); she has a useful pedigree and is in good hands to progress; possible player on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Perfect Part
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with headgear addition suggesting connections expect improvement after recent promising fourths
runners_data.comment: Promising fourth on two of her three starts this season; might not be far away
runners_data.spotlight: She's been a promising fourth on two of her three starts this season, at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) in March and here (7f, good) a fortnight ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained); might not be far away.

runners_data.name: Renewal
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 239 days since last run creates fitness concerns despite solid historical form
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 4yo who could have a big part to play back down to 1m on her reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 4232 in novice/maiden events on turf and again ran well when runner-up on handicap debut at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last October; shaped on that latest outing as though the drop back in trip may be a positive and this unexposed 4yo could have a big part to play on her reappearance.

runners_data.name: Mandarin Spirit
runners_data.note: Front runner who may struggle with Krissy for early lead after disappointing handicap debut last month
runners_data.comment: Could improve for handicap debut sixth but claims aren't compelling on the back of that
runners_data.spotlight: Won a maiden here (7f, good) last July on second start; well beaten in Group 2 next time; she could improve for this month's reappearance sixth on handicap debut at Beverley (7.4f, good to soft) but her claims aren't compelling on the back of that.

runners_data.name: Bridget's View
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist but poor recent turf form raises questions about current ability level
runners_data.comment: Ran well as recently as February but down the field on both starts since
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Southwell (1m, AW) in December and very close fifth at Lingfield (7f, AW) in February; however, down the field on both starts since (7f, AW/good) and needs to leave those performances well behind.

runners_data.name: Annastarzy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner on fair mark but needs to prove handicap credentials after moderate recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Promise in novice races but merely eighth of 12 on handicap debut at Windsor
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo who appears to be on a fair mark judged on her novice form; still early days in handicaps but she was merely eighth of 12 at Windsor (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago on her first attempt in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Alessia Fernanda
runners_data.note: Prominent style with wind surgery boost but 3lb claimer adds inexperience factor in competitive heat
runners_data.comment: Returned to form with reappearance win at Southwell; remains on workable mark back up 4lb
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time turf winner who returned to form with a reappearance win at Southwell (1m, AW) last month, following wind surgery; back up 4lb she remains on a workable mark and could be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Krissy
runners_data.note: Front runner in career-best form with two recent wins but faces stronger opposition and tactical pressure
runners_data.spotlight: Easily made all at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) ten days ago and did likewise under a 5lb penalty in apprentice handicap at Carlisle (1m1f, good) on Friday; unpenalised for latest win but new mark has kicked in, which is 6lb higher than that which she raced off two days ago; in a tougher race today but clearly thriving and she's a leading candidate if her fine form continues.

runners_data.name: Wetsand
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to favored mile trip after disappointing shorter distance efforts recently
runners_data.comment: Yarmouth last time was a step back in the right direction but she needs another today
runners_data.spotlight: 1m 2yo winner last August and the return to this trip could help; kept on for fifth of eight at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) last month, which was a step back in the right direction, but she needs another today.

runners_data.name: Geo
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with good recent win but quick turnaround of 11 days may impact performance
runners_data.comment: Narrowly exploited a reduced mark at Ayr; this is more competitive but she's up just 2lb
runners_data.spotlight: Exploited a reduced mark when returning to form with a narrow win at Ayr (1m, good to firm) 11 days ago; this is more competitive but she's gone back up just 2lb and is not discounted.

races.paceDynamic: Mandarin Spirit and Krissy will dispute the early lead, with both having strong front-running tendencies and recent form suggesting they'll go forward from the gates. Behind them, a significant traffic jam develops with Bintaziza, Thankfully, Renewal, Annastarzy, Alessia Fernanda, and Wetsand all wanting prominent positions - that's half the field cramming into the first four lengths. The dual pace angle up front should create an honest gallop over this flat mile, but the prominent congestion will cause interference and positioning battles from halfway. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and benefit from the strong pace, making Thaluna, Perfect Part, Bridget's View, and Geo the tactical beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Mandarin Spirit and Krissy go too fast early in their pace battle
scenarios.body: The leaders weaken significantly in the final two furlongs as the honest gallop takes its toll, allowing closers with clean runs to sweep past. Hold-up specialists get ideal conditions with plenty of pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners cause serious interference from the three-furlong pole
scenarios.body: Multiple horses get hampered or forced wide in the congested pack, creating an uneven contest where position matters more than ability. Those who avoid the chaos or secure early prominent spots without traffic prosper.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Favor
scenarios.trigger: If one leader establishes control without serious pressure from the other
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more manageable, reducing the advantage for hold-up horses and allowing the prominent runners to maintain their position more effectively. Well-positioned horses with tactical speed can strike from ideal spots.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Krissy uses her recent winning momentum to establish a clear lead without serious challenge
scenarios.body: Her excellent recent form and proven front-running ability allow her to dictate terms and maintain enough energy for the finish despite the tactical disadvantage. The pace battle fails to materialize properly.

watchPoints.text: Serious interference likely from three furlongs out as Bintaziza, Thankfully, Renewal, Annastarzy, Alessia Fernanda and Wetsand fight for prominent positions
Mandarin Spirit and Krissy pace battle could set up collapse if both refuse to compromise early
Perfect Part benefits significantly if headgear addition sparks improvement to match her recent promising efforts
Renewal's 239-day absence creates fitness doubt despite being well-treated by handicapper on old form
Thaluna represents strongest closer credentials with Daniel Tudhope booking suggesting Haggas targets this race
